events.description: Regular classes commence for all UG and PG programs.
Welcome session for first-year students. Vice-Chancellor's address, department introductions. Osmania University campus, 9 AM - 4 PM.
Last date for course registration via OU DOST portal. Late registration with penalty after this date.
First internal assessments / cycle tests for all departments. Schedule on department notice boards.
Flag hoisting at 8:30 AM by Vice-Chancellor. Cultural program by fine arts department. Arts College main auditorium.
Enrollment for National Service Scheme units. Community service and special camp participation.

events.event: Prof. Jayashankar Memorial Lecture Series Begins
events.description: Annual lecture series honoring Prof. K. Jayashankar. Distinguished academicians deliver lectures on social justice and education. Osmania University, Senate Hall.
Student-organized tribute to teachers. Cultural performances, speech competitions, felicitation of senior faculty.
3-day workshop on research methodology for PG and PhD scholars. Topics: literature review, data analysis, SPSS. Department of Statistics.
Second internal assessments. Lab practicals and mid-term evaluations.
Ganesh idol installation at Osmania University campus. Cultural events organized by student unions. 3-day festivities.
Annual blood donation drive organized by NSS in collaboration with Osmania General Hospital. Student Center, 9 AM - 5 PM.
National holiday. Swachh Bharat drive organized by NSS and Eco Club.
All Hyderabad inter-college debate. Theme: 'Youth and Governance'. Open to UG/PG students. Registration deadline: October 1.
Week-long inter-college competitions: classical dance, folk music, drama, painting, poetry recitation. Fine Arts department.
Cricket tournament with teams from 16 colleges. OU Cricket Ground, matches daily from 3 PM.
Finals and prize distribution ceremony. Chief Minister's Education Award winners felicitated.
Shortage of attendance lists displayed. Students below 75% must meet class in-charge immediately.
Festival break. University closed from October 22-26. Classes resume October 27.
Third internal assessments. Comprehensive evaluations and lab record submission.
Aptitude training and soft skills workshops for final year students. Placement cell.
Football tournament at OU Sports Complex. Teams from all affiliated colleges.
Annual research paper presentation by PG scholars. Best paper awards in each department.
Festival holiday. University closed November 12-14.
Last day of regular classes. Complete all internal assessment submissions.
Odd semester final examinations commence. Hall tickets available on OU portal.
Final examinations conclude. Winter vacation begins.
College closed for Christmas.
Classes commence for even semester. Check timetable on OU DOST portal.
Continuation of memorial lecture series. Eminent scholars on caste and social reform movements. Senate Hall.
Advanced workshop: qualitative research, NVivo, thesis writing. Open to all PG/PhD scholars.
Festival holiday. Campus decorated with rangoli and pongal celebrations.
First internal assessments begin for even semester.
Flag hoisting at 8:00 AM by Vice-Chancellor. Parade and cultural program. Arts College grounds.
Week-long sports festival. Events: cricket, football, basketball, badminton, athletics, chess, volleyball, kabaddi. OU Sports Complex.
Finals and closing ceremony. Chief Guest: Telangana Sports Minister. Prize distribution.
48th Convocation of Osmania University. Degrees awarded to all qualifying students. Nizam College Grounds, 10 AM.
Second internal assessments. Mid-term evaluations and lab examinations.
All-Hyderabad technical paper presentation. Topics: AI, ML, Data Science, Cybersecurity, IoT. Registration deadline: February 15.
Science exhibition, poster presentation, inter-department quiz. Department of Physics and Chemistry open labs.
Annual cultural festival of Osmania University. 4-day extravaganza: music, dance, drama, literary events, fashion show, pro-night. Campus-wide.
Tarnam finale. Pro-night with celebrity performance. Prize distribution and closing ceremony. Main auditorium.
Programs by Women's Cell and ICC. Guest lectures on women empowerment, self-defense workshop. Arts College.
Women's cultural festival 'Tarangini'. Events: classical dance, light music, rangoli, mehendi, cookery. PG women's college campus.
Tarangini finale with prize distribution and cultural evening. Chief Guest: noted cultural personality.
Third internal assessments. Project reviews for final year students.
Festival of colors celebration at OU campus. Organic colors only. Arts College lawn, 11 AM - 3 PM.
48-hour hackathon organized by Department of Computer Science. Theme: Smart Governance. Prizes worth ₹2 lakhs.
Recruitment drives begin. Final year students: update placement portal and resume. T&P cell.
TCS campus recruitment PPT. Mandatory for registered students. Placement cell auditorium, 2 PM.
Fourth internal assessments. Comprehensive evaluations before final exams.
Holiday. Dr. B.R. Ambedkar tribute ceremony at Arts College.
National holiday.
Last day of regular classes. Submit all assignments, lab records, and project reports.
Final year students: project defense and viva. Check department schedule for slots.
Even semester final examinations commence. Hall tickets on OU portal.
Final examinations conclude. Summer vacation begins.
Last date to register for supplementary/backlog examinations. Academic section.
Final year students register on OU placement portal. Resume building workshop.
Weekly aptitude training. Mock tests for AMCAT, Cocubes, eLitmus. Placement cell.
Companies visit for pre-placement presentations. Mandatory for registered students.
IT mass recruiters (TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, HCL) conduct campus drives.
Core engineering, banking, and consulting companies visit campus.
Public sector companies (IOCL, NTPC, BHEL, DRDO) campus recruitment.
Additional drives and off-campus placement support by T&P cell.

important_deadlines.description: Course registration deadline via OU DOST portal
Hostel application deadline for odd semester
GRE/GMAT score planning deadline for higher studies abroad
Course registration for even semester via OU DOST
Hostel application deadline for even semester
Income certificate renewal for scholarship students
